_readme: Maps every page of 'Javatri Food Items (2).pdf' onto the menu in javatri-menu.json.
Written by hand after reading all 82 pages and all 180 existing dishes, because a fuzzy
name match cannot tell 'Veg Manchurian' (a new dish) from 'Gobi Manchurian' (an existing
one), and getting that wrong either loses a dish or duplicates it.
match:  the PDF dish IS this existing dish. The existing record is updated in place and
keeps its slug, so its id never changes. Only name, price, description and image
new:    the PDF dish does not exist on the site. Added to the stated category.
dup:    a second page for a dish already claimed by another page. Says which page's text
and which page's photograph won, and why.
Re-runnable: scripts/import-pdf-menu.mjs reads this and rewrites javatri-menu.json.

why_these_are_the_same_dish.2: Methi Chicken / Methi Murgh — murgh is chicken. Same fenugreek chicken curry, same £15.95.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.10: Paneer Pakoda / Paneer Pakoda (5 pieces) — the site name just carries the portion count.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.15: Kadai Chicken / Kadai Murg — murgh is chicken.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.32: Chicken Dumpling / Chicken Momos — the site's own description reads 'steamed dumplings stuffed with juicy minced chicken', and both are £7.95.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.33: Lamb Dumpling / Lamb Momos — same wording, both £7.95.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.38: Tadka Dal / Dal Tadka — word order.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.43: Tawa Sabzi / Veg Tawa Fry — vegetables on the tawa, both £13.50.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.45: Okra Fries / Okra Fries / Kurkuri Bhindi — kurkuri bhindi IS okra fries.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.52: Tandoori Panner shashlick / Tandoori Paneer Shashlick — 'Panner' is a typo in the PDF.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.58: Lamb Rogan Josh / Rogan Josh — rogan josh is a lamb dish; the site name omits the meat.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.60: Mix Sharing Platter / Mixed Tandoori Grill — both £20.95, and the PDF's four items (malai chicken, chicken tikka, lamb, prawns) are the site's 'four types of tandoori kebab and tikka'.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.61: Chilli Fish / Fish Chilli — word order.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.62: Onion & Spinach Bhaji / Onion and Spinach Bhaji — ampersand.
why_these_are_the_same_dish.64: Dilli wala Butter Chicken / Butter Chicken Dilli Wala — word order.

18.note: Dahi Bhalla appears twice. Page 72 wins outright: its description names the lentil ('fluffy lentil dumplings in cool yogurt with sweet and tangy chutneys') where page 18 just says 'soft dumplings', and its photograph is the larger file. The two photographs are the same shot.

31.note: Chicken Tikka Shahslick appears twice with identical text and price. Page 20 wins on the photograph alone — 1440x1152 against page 31's 1440x810.

65.note: Chilli Chicken appears twice, both £11.45, and the two pages disagree. Page 65 has the better sentence ('stir-fried chicken with fiery chillies and aromatic spices'); page 24's reads 'tossed in spicy, tangy sauced with vegetables', which is mistyped. Page 24 has the better photograph at 1440x1152 against 1440x810. Taking the description from 65 and the image from 24 rather than accepting a typo or a smaller picture.

confirmed_by_owner.10: Price £10.95. The PDF page prints '10.95' with no currency symbol.
confirmed_by_owner.71: Name 'Chicken Changezi on the Bone'. The page has its name and description transposed, so the name reads as a sentence fragment.
